agents.name: Alisha Richardson
agents.title: Director Of Operations
agents.about:
Alisha Richardson has excelled in management and leadership throughout her 22-year career in the real estate industry. Now serving as Director of Operations, Alisha oversees all facets of the Wilmington office of RE/MAX Essential, which merged with RE/MAX Southern Shores in 2024. This partnership allows the team to serve even more clients along the coast, from Topsail Beach, North Carolina to Charleston, South Carolina.

Alisha began her career in real estate after earning a bachelor’s degree in Communication Studies from the University of North Carolina Wilmington in December 2002. Having worked alongside some of the most experienced agents in the area, she takes great pride in supporting their growth and celebrating their success at every level.

Known for her passion for people and her gracious heart, Alisha thrives when others succeed—not only within the organization, but in life as well. Her relentless work ethic continues to positively impact the growth of RE/MAX Essential, as well as the agents and staff she supports.

Alisha is also dedicated to giving back to the community. She proudly serves on the Board of Directors for Wilmington Area Rebuilding Ministry (WARM NC), helping support efforts to make homes safer and healthier for local residents.

Outside of the office, Alisha enjoys spending time with her daughter Natalie and her husband Andy, who is also part of the real estate industry.

Deirdre Hecht is a passionate now Broker, Realtor® committed to helping clients achieve their homeownership dreams. With expertise in MA, RI, and FL markets, her 17-year Retail Banking background adds a unique advantage to real estate transactions. Deirdre specializes in First-Time Buyers, Probate & Estate Sales, Second/Investment Properties, Divorce Transactions, and Senior Real Estate needs. Born in Massachusetts, Deirdre relocated to Newport County, RI in 2018 and made a second home investment o the West Coast, FL in 2023. She is part of REMAX Professionals of Newport and Preferred Properties of Venice, Inc, aligning with over 40 years of industry experience. Through these affiliations, she offers access to a powerful industry leading global referral network, enabling a connection of clients to respected real estate professionals worldwide. 

As a member of the State-Wide MLS, MLS PIN and Stellar MLS, REMAX Worldwide Network, National Association of Realtors, and The Newport County Board of Realtors, she stays at the forefront of industry knowledge and resources. She additionally has been designated a Senior Real Estate Specialist® (SRES®), Short Sale & Foreclosure Resource (SFR®), Resort & Second Property Specialist (RSPS®), Pricing Strategy Advisor (PSA®) and REMAX Golf Lifestyle Designee.  

When not working with clients, she enjoys volunteering, golfing, networking and spending time with her family and rescue dogs.

For buying or selling inquiries, connect with Deirdre and let’s @Smoothsailingre to you next home destination!

Real estate has always been a family business for me. I grew up immersed in the industry—my mother, Janet Cox, has been a Realtor for over 20 years, and my father is a builder who worked for Anthony & Son Builders. From an early age, I learned that real estate is about more than buying and selling homes; it’s about helping people put down roots, build stability, and create a place where life happens.

After earning my master’s degree in human resources from Western Carolina University, I returned home to help grow our family business. My real estate career began in 2009, and over the years I’ve worked in many roles within the industry, including agent assistant, property management, and office manager at RE/MAX Lifestyle. These experiences have given me a well-rounded understanding of the process from every angle. Today, I’m proud to serve as a second-generation Realtor, continuing a legacy built on trust, strong communication, and exceeding expectations.

I guide my clients through buying, selling, and investing with clarity, care, and honest communication. Having seen both the challenges and successes of the real estate world, I understand how important it is to feel informed and supported when making major decisions. My goal is to help you move forward with confidence, knowing you have a knowledgeable advocate by your side.

I’ve been married for 6 years and am a mom to two young children, Josephine and Alexander. Josie attended her first closing at 2 weeks old. They’ve been to home inspections, and showings. This connection is what makes Rooted in Home more than a brand to me; it reflects how I live, work, and serve the families I help every day.

Whether you’re buying your first home, selling, investing, or planning your next chapter, I’m here to guide you with experience, integrity, and a legacy you can trust.
